yates_mentzer.label: Modified Yates / Mentzer
yates_mentzer.note: Low volume, high intensity, reps-before-load, RPE 9-10. The current default.

hit.label: Pure HIT / Heavy Duty (Mentzer)
hit.note: One all-out set to failure, minimal volume, no backoffs, long rest, bigger jumps when earned.

volume.label: High-Volume Hypertrophy (GVT-style)
volume.note: More sets, moderate RPE 8-9, higher rep ranges, smaller load jumps.

strength_rpt.label: Strength 5x5 / Reverse Pyramid
strength_rpt.note: Lower reps, bigger load jumps, lower RPE caps, more warmups; backoffs as ~10% drops.

5_3_1.label: 5/3/1 (Jim Wendler)
5_3_1.note: Training Max = 90% of an estimated 1RM (Epley-shaped heuristic; e1rm_reps_coefficient/training_max_rounding_lb engine constants are added by plan 05.3-04, not here). Canonical main-lift exercise_keys per this plan's Task 1 option-b ratification (2026-08-17, Chad Crawford, Program Director): no substitution -- squat/bench/press map to their canonical equipment_movement exercise identities (app/ontology/movement_cluster_map.json, app/ontology/exercise_identity_registry.py). All four main lifts have zero logged qualifying top sets in live session_sets data as of 2026-08-17, so the Training Max heuristic correctly refuses a number for every lift until at least one is actually trained -- intended RC-E discipline, not a defect. `deadlift`'s exercise_keys is deliberately empty: the only conventional-deadlift entry found in the ontology is the bare, unqualified string "deadlift" (movement_cluster_map.json's hip_hinge cluster), which breaks the equipment-qualified naming convention every other canonical exercise id in this codebase follows and has no corroborating entry in exercise_identity_registry.py or exercise_alias_map.json -- left unmapped per Task 1's own escape hatch rather than guessed. Follow-up: confirm a real canonical conventional-deadlift id when the ontology is extended.

linear_periodization.label: Linear Periodization (classic strength)
linear_periodization.note: Classic 12-week linear block: hypertrophy (wk1-4) -> strength (wk5-8) -> power/peak (wk9-12); intensity_basis=one_rm (not Training Max, no warmup_sets ratified for this profile). Canonical main-lift exercise_keys per this plan's Task 1 option-b ratification (2026-08-17, Chad Crawford, Program Director): no substitution, same mapping as 5_3_1. All four main lifts have zero logged qualifying top sets in live session_sets data as of 2026-08-17. `deadlift`'s exercise_keys is deliberately empty for the same reason documented on the 5_3_1 profile -- no confidently-canonical conventional-deadlift exercise id exists yet in this codebase's ontology.

repeated_set_fatigue_decay_threshold.ratifying_authority: phase 06.3.1 decision D-02; plan 06.3.1-01 Task 2 checkpoint:decision (gate=blocking), option-a: 'D-02 = 0.25, D-03 = 0.50'
repeated_set_fatigue_decay_threshold.note: The fraction of same-load, comparable-RPE (|delta RPE| <= 1.0) rep decay between a working set and its immediately preceding working set at which the later set is treated as fatigue-decayed rather than a genuine progression signal. Measured against live volm.duckdb by tools/measure_repeated_set_fatigue_decay.py: 249 qualifying pairs, 31 fires at >=25% = 12.4% fire rate -- this is RESEARCH.md's own ad hoc figure, now reproduced by a committed, reproducible instrument rather than a session snippet. Cleared comparison anchors: under the 30% halt-threshold precedent set in phases 06.2/06.3, and within 0.6 points of phase 06.2's own ratified 13.0% check-K fire rate. Confirmed to fire on the Day B Incline Bench audit repro (165x9@9, 137.5x9@9, 137.5x6@9: set 2->3 is same-load, |delta RPE|=0, decay=(9-6)/9=33.3%, fires at 25%). A change here supersedes a ratified value -- edit only with a new, explicit ratification, not silently.

anomalous_set_rep_gain_threshold.ratifying_authority: phase 06.3.1 decision D-03; plan 06.3.1-01 Task 2 checkpoint:decision (gate=blocking), option-a: 'D-02 = 0.25, D-03 = 0.50'
anomalous_set_rep_gain_threshold.note: The fraction of rep gain between a working set and its immediately preceding working set, where the later set's effective load is at or below the earlier set's, and the later set's RPE is at or below the earlier set's RPE, above which the later set is hard-excluded from progression anchoring as an anomalous outlier rather than blended into the top-set signal. Measured against live volm.duckdb by tools/measure_repeated_set_fatigue_decay.py: 370 qualifying pairs, 22 fires at >=50% = 5.9% fire rate -- deliberately conservative (25 percentage points of margin below the Day C Hanging Leg Raise repro's 75% gain), chosen because this constant's consequence (hard exclusion from progression anchoring) is harsher and less reversible than D-02's (a load reduction). Cleared comparison anchors: well under the 30% halt-threshold precedent set in phases 06.2/06.3, and confirmed to fire on the Day C Hanging Leg Raise audit repro (8@9 then 14@8: same/lower load, lower RPE (8<=9), gain=(14-8)/8=75%, fires at 50%). Comparison basis for the D-03 detector: a later working set whose effective load is at or below an earlier working set's, whose RPE is at or below that earlier set's, and whose reps exceed that earlier set's by at least this fraction. A change here supersedes a ratified value -- edit only with a new, explicit ratification, not silently.
